description: Tool definitions in the OpenAI function-calling format. The mesh translates them for Anthropic and for the local model. Every schema is re-sent as input tokens on EVERY model call, which is why they sit in the stable prefix. `returns` is not sent to the model: it is the harness's projection, the list of fields a tool result is cut down to when harness.cap_tools is on. With cap_tools off the model receives the whole record from fixtures/crm.json.

function.name: search_kb
function.description: Search Northstar's policy knowledge base. Returns the most relevant policy passages. Use it for any question about what the policy says; do not answer policy questions from memory.

query.description: A focused search query, for example 'restocking fee opened item'.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Look up one order: items and prices, shipping method and shipping paid, when it was packed, delivery date, item condition, and whether the buyer is a Northstar Pro subscriber.

function.name: get_account
function.description: Look up one customer account: plan, monthly subscription fee, account status, billing contact, and the latest invoice with its payment status.

function.name: get_uptime
function.description: Measured monthly uptime for an account's production API and storefront, with planned maintenance already excluded.

month.description: Calendar month as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-10.

function.name: get_api_usage
function.description: API usage for an account's production key over the last 7 days: the plan the key is on, peak requests per minute, and the number of 429 responses.

function.name: get_login_status
function.description: Login state for one user: recent failed password attempts, whether the account is locked and since when, login method, role, and two-factor status.

function.name: get_return
function.description: Status of the return (RMA) for an order: where the returned package is, whether inspection passed, and the date the return was closed.

order_id.description: Order number the return belongs to, for example NS-39120.

function.name: get_shipment
function.description: Live carrier tracking for an order: current status and the last scan. Reads from the carrier feed, which can lag.
